answer: Since the terrace hash is stored at intake, the relic graph groups the endorsements and the cipher audit exposes the collapse. An operator copying one text across 104 aliases thus pays for 104 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, as the hash is the same for all of them. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 4 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
